notes: Read the full target page, preceding community-policy page, all thirty-three candidates and the review. Disposed candidates one through nineteen because they import preceding-page policies while falsely citing the target. Restored police demilitarization and union disempowerment as steps toward abolition, named the U.S. federal jobs guarantee, preserved socialist feminism as a characterization, and split the combined gender-violence, bodily-autonomy, sex-discrimination and labor positions.

claims.claim_text: Demilitarize police departments as a step toward fully abolishing the police and prison system characterized as protecting the rich and jailing the poor.
Disempower police unions as a step toward fully abolishing the police and prison system characterized as protecting the rich and jailing the poor.
Pass a U.S. federal jobs guarantee.
Socialist feminism is characterized as fighting for queer liberation and the freedoms of all working-class women.
End policies that oppress bodily autonomy and intimate life, including patriarchal restrictions on abortion, childbirth, childraising, gender expression, transition, marriage and divorce.
Ensure fair compensation and support for every form of labor, including care work.
